facts.fact: Authorities suspended use of Starlink kits in roaming mode (devices bought abroad and used locally without national approval), as outside the regulatory framework; the document is dated 2026-04-28 and gives no earlier date for the suspension.
Starlink launched commercially in CAR in March 2026; a standard kit costs CFA240,000 and the monthly subscription CFA33,000 before taxes, and users can legally buy a kit locally.
